WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.content_id,c.client_id,c.source_message_id,c.current_version_id,v.version,v.briefing,v.copy,v.generated_image_path,
    ro.layout_spec,ro.source_image_path,ro.template_id,ro.renderer,cr.change_request_id,cr.interpreted_changes,cr.approval_id,
    (SELECT COALESCE(max(version),0)+1 FROM social_media.content_versions WHERE content_id=c.content_id) AS next_version
  FROM social_media.content_items c
  JOIN social_media.content_versions v ON v.id=c.current_version_id
  JOIN social_media.render_outputs ro ON ro.version_id=v.id AND ro.status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL'
  JOIN social_media.change_requests cr ON cr.content_id=c.content_id AND cr.source_version_id=v.id
  WHERE c.content_id=$1 AND v.id=$2::uuid AND cr.change_request_id=$3::uuid
    AND c.status='CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND cr.status='INTERPRETED' AND cr.target_version_id IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE OF c,cr
), new_version AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.content_versions (content_id,version,change_request,briefing,copy,generated_image_path)
  SELECT content_id,next_version,jsonb_build_object('change_request_id',change_request_id,'source_version_id',current_version_id,'changes',interpreted_changes),briefing,copy,generated_image_path FROM eligible
  RETURNING id,content_id,version,version_label
), paths AS (
  SELECT e.*,n.id AS target_version_id,n.version AS target_version,n.version_label,
    'assets/generated/'||regexp_replace(e.client_id,'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]','-','g')||'/'||e.content_id||'/rendered/final-v'||n.version||'.png' AS output_path,
    'assets/generated/'||regexp_replace(e.client_id,'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]','-','g')||'/'||e.content_id||'/specs/layout-v'||n.version||'.json' AS layout_spec_path
  FROM eligible e JOIN new_version n ON n.content_id=e.content_id
), render_started AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.render_outputs (content_id,version_id,template_id,renderer,source_image_path,final_art_path,layout_spec_path,status)
  SELECT content_id,target_version_id,template_id,renderer,source_image_path,output_path,layout_spec_path,'CREATING_ART' FROM paths RETURNING render_id,version_id
), request_updated AS (
  UPDATE social_media.change_requests cr SET target_version_id=p.target_version_id,status='REVISION_IN_PROGRESS',updated_at=now() FROM paths p WHERE cr.change_request_id=p.change_request_id RETURNING cr.change_request_id
), content_updated AS (
  UPDATE social_media.content_items c SET status='RENDERING',updated_at=now() FROM paths p WHERE c.content_id=p.content_id RETURNING c.content_id
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details)
  SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),p.client_id,p.content_id,e.event_type,'06.1 - Orquestrador de Revisao',e.details
  FROM paths p LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=p.source_message_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('REVISION_STARTED',jsonb_build_object('change_request_id',p.change_request_id,'source_version_id',p.current_version_id,'target_version_id',p.target_version_id,'version_label',p.version_label)),
    ('ART_RENDER_STARTED',jsonb_build_object('render_id',(SELECT render_id FROM render_started),'version_id',p.target_version_id,'renderer',p.renderer,'mode','revision'))
  ) e(event_type,details)
)
SELECT p.content_id,p.client_id,p.current_version_id::text AS source_version_id,p.target_version_id::text AS version_id,p.version_label,p.change_request_id::text,p.template_id,p.renderer,p.layout_spec,p.interpreted_changes AS changes,p.output_path,p.layout_spec_path FROM paths p;

WITH ctx AS (SELECT cr.*,a.client_id,a.channel,a.message_id,m.correlation_id FROM social_media.change_requests cr JOIN social_media.approvals a ON a.approval_id=cr.approval_id LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=a.message_id WHERE cr.change_request_id=$1::uuid AND cr.target_version_id=$2::uuid),
render_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.render_outputs SET layout_spec=$3::jsonb,width=$4::int,height=$5::int,checksum_sha256=$6,status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL',rendered_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE version_id=$2::uuid RETURNING render_id),
version_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_versions SET final_art_path=$7 WHERE id=$2::uuid RETURNING version_label),
request_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.change_requests SET applied_changes=$8::jsonb,status='APPLIED',applied_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE change_request_id=$1::uuid RETURNING change_request_id),
content_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items c SET current_version_id=$2::uuid,final_art_path=$7,status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL',updated_at=now() FROM ctx WHERE c.content_id=ctx.content_id RETURNING c.content_id),
events AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,ctx.content_id,e.event_type,'06.1 - Orquestrador de Revisao',e.details FROM ctx CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 ('LAYOUT_UPDATED',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'change_request_id',$1::uuid,'applied_changes',$8::jsonb)),
 ('ART_RENDERED',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'render_id',(SELECT render_id FROM render_ready),'width',$4::int,'height',$5::int,'checksum_sha256',$6)),
 ('REVISION_CREATED',jsonb_build_object('source_version_id',ctx.source_version_id,'target_version_id',$2::uuid,'version_label',(SELECT version_label FROM version_ready))),
 ('ART_READY_FOR_APPROVAL',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'final_art_path',$7,'layout_spec_path',$9,'checksum_sha256',$6))
) e(event_type,details) RETURNING event_id),
outbound AS (INSERT INTO social_media.messages(correlation_id,client_id,channel,direction,sender_id,body,raw_payload) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,ctx.channel,'OUTBOUND','system','Perfeito. Fiz a alteração solicitada e preparei uma nova versão para aprovação.',jsonb_build_object('content_id',ctx.content_id,'version_id',$2::uuid,'change_request_id',$1::uuid) FROM ctx RETURNING message_id)
SELECT ctx.content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,(SELECT version_label FROM version_ready) AS version_label,'changes_requested'::text AS decision,'READY_FOR_APPROVAL'::text AS status,$7::text AS final_art_path,$9::text AS layout_spec_path,$6::text AS checksum_sha256,$8::jsonb AS applied_changes,(SELECT render_id FROM render_ready) AS render_id,(SELECT message_id FROM outbound) AS outbound_message_id,'Perfeito. Fiz a alteração solicitada e preparei uma nova versão para aprovação.'::text AS automatic_response,true AS automated FROM ctx;

WITH ctx AS (SELECT cr.content_id,cr.change_request_id,cr.target_version_id,a.client_id,m.correlation_id FROM social_media.change_requests cr JOIN social_media.approvals a ON a.approval_id=cr.approval_id LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=a.message_id WHERE cr.change_request_id=$1::uuid AND cr.target_version_id=$2::uuid),
render_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.render_outputs SET status=CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,error_message=$3,updated_at=now() WHERE version_id=$2::uuid RETURNING render_id),
request_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.change_requests SET status='FAILED',updated_at=now() WHERE change_request_id=$1::uuid RETURNING change_request_id),
content_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items c SET status=CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,updated_at=now() FROM ctx WHERE c.content_id=ctx.content_id RETURNING c.content_id),
events AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,severity,details) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,ctx.content_id,e.event_type,'06.1 - Orquestrador de Revisao','ERROR',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'change_request_id',$1::uuid,'error',$3,'error_code',$4,'validation',$5::jsonb) FROM ctx CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'RENDER_FAILED' END),('REVISION_FAILED')) e(event_type))
SELECT ctx.content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'FAILED' END AS status,$3::text AS error,$5::jsonb AS validation,false AS automated FROM ctx;
